messages:
Maya CSM: Heads-up — Aperture Labs showed a 3x spike in embed calls overnight, looks like onboarding tests. Anyone tracking? :eyes:
Jon FinOps: I saw a budget alert come through at 02:18 UTC. They're on the growth credits plan, alert flagged at 81% of monthly quota. Pulling the ledger now.
Priya Enablement: They were running through the guided demo flows today. I asked them to avoid bulk evals but they might have kicked off a batch job.
Theo Data: Quick query I ran: `select sum(tokens) from usage where account = 'aperture' and ts >= now() - interval '12 hours'` — result ~= 1.2M tokens, mostly embeddings.
Alerts Bot: budget-alert: Aperture Labs exceeded 80% of monthly credits (notified: Maya CSM).
Maya CSM: Ok — we need a 1-pager for QBR prep: token econ summary, short-term forecast, and enablement checklist before Tue. Can @Jon and @Priya pick this up?
Jon FinOps: Will do. Initial projection: at current burn rate they'll hit their paid commit in ~18 days. I'll produce a 90-day runway table and a suggested promo top-up.
Priya Enablement: I can push a safe-demo config to their sandbox: reduce context window, switch to `dense-first` for vector ops, and add a client-side rate limit. Will prepare a step-by-step.
Theo Data: Running a quick breakdown — top 3 prompt templates responsible for ~72% of the tokens: `long_vector_index`, `batch-embed-run`, `full-doc-search`. Most calls originate from host `demo-01`.
Maya CSM: Action items (short):
- Jon: numeric forecast + suggested promo amount + temp soft-cap.
- Priya: demo config push + one-pager for the customer call.
- Theo: confirm which calls came from demo vs prod and add logs to the ticket.
Anyone blocked?
Jon FinOps: No blockers. Proposing temporary throttle: `quota.embed_per_min = 5000` for their account during onboarding flows. I'll include thresholds and an auto-alert at 60% usage.
Priya Enablement: :thumbsup: I'll also record customer feedback and a recommended smaller default vector index. I'll link the internal playbook: <https://redwood.app/playbooks/onboarding-costs> in the one-pager.
Maya CSM: Please add a short risk blurb for the QBR deck: "unexpected embed run during onboarding — recommended mitigation: demo config + promo tokens."
Theo Data: Confirmed — 87% of the spike traced to `demo-01` host and a single API key used by their engineering team. I'll annotate spans in tracing and attach the CSV.
Maya CSM: @Jon can you suggest a promo credit amount? We want to smooth the experience but not oversubscribe.
Jon FinOps: Suggest 150k promo tokens + auto-alert at 60%. If they accept, we can front-load 50k immediately and the rest contingent on engagement metrics.
Alerts Bot: action-logged: ticket CS-7894 created for Aperture Labs — owner: Maya CSM.
Maya CSM: Great — I'll schedule a 20-min sync with the customer tomorrow and drop the one-pager in the QBR prep folder. Will update CS-7894 with meeting notes.
Priya Enablement: Capturing their feedback now — request to make vector-index defaults smaller and clearer doc samples. I'll add it to feedback tracker.
Jon FinOps: I'll post the finalized forecast and runway table to #customer-success-docs in 30m and attach CSV.
Maya CSM: Thanks team :raised_hands: — follow-ups tracked in CS-7894. Close out here once your items are uploaded.
